items.difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that an injective abelian sheaf is injective as an abelian presheaf (statement lines 1318-1322). The proof identifies the forgetful functor as the right adjoint of the sheafification functor (proof lines 1324-1328) and applies the general fact that a right adjoint of an exact functor preserves injectives (proof lines 1328-1331). The non-formal content is the exactness of sheafification. The claim is H2: one adjunction plus one formal consequence.
